counterargs.read: This reads like pre-event consolidation rather than a genuine regime signal: yields ticked up a touch, equity vol firmed slightly, and the dollar strengthened — all consistent with modest hedging ahead of Jackson Hole — while oil's sharp decline and continued credit tightening are the more durable, multi-day trends. Confidence in any single narrative should stay low until Warsh's debut speech and the H.4.1 print (both tomorrow) are in hand.
